_readme: Optional map for the fleet runner (21-Fleet\Get-ManagedFleet.ps1 and Invoke-ToolkitFleet.ps1). Maps a friendly company name to its Zabbix host group, AD OU, and (optionally) a per-company Config folder under Config\Companies\<name>\. Without this file, -Company is treated as the Zabbix host-group name directly. Add one block per customer.
